video_title: The Pistons are 'vehemently against' trading Jalen Duren - Shams 👀 | NBA on ESPN

quotes.speaker: Mike Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown on the Knicks' high standards for title defense
quotes.excerpt: we can't afford to have any slippage in our process
quotes.quote: Regardless of what we accomplished moving forward, our standard and how we approach our process is going to be real critical. It's going to be really critical for us. We can't afford to have any slippage in our process.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the Knicks' mindset for repeating as champions
quotes.excerpt: our mindset everything has to be the same if not better as it was last year
quotes.quote: Whatever terminology we want to use, whether it's repeating or defending a title, the opportunity is to go win a championship every single year. Our mindset everything has to be the same if not better as it was last year. I think we have the confidence knowing that we did do it. That's going to help us but that can also hurt us. It's all about how we go into training camp and how we go into these first few weeks to see where we are as a team.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on his desire to sign a contract extension
quotes.excerpt: I would like to get it done so I could step on the court and feel comfortable
quotes.quote: I've made it known I want to play here. I've been a fan since I was young. I would like to get it done, of course. Obviously, I would like to get it done so I could step on the court and feel comfortable, it's possible.

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: Vincent Goodwill on the lack of progress in Knicks contract negotiations
quotes.excerpt: there hasn't even been talks that have advanced the discussions

text_blocks.speaker: Jorge Sedano
text_blocks.text: Where do things stand with the extension between KAT and the Knicks?

text_blocks.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
text_blocks.text: Things don't stand anywhere. There doesn't look to be a considerable offer on the table, at least not one to Karl-Anthony Towns' liking. I'm told there hasn't even been talks that have advanced the discussions. It's basically the offer is the offer. When you consider Karl-Anthony Towns hasn't gotten an extension, Josh Hart hasn't gotten an extension, and Miles McBride has not gotten an extension, for a team that wants to repeat, you want to have all of your ducks in a row.

quotes.speaker: Trajan Langdon
quotes.summary_phrase: Trajan Langdon on the lack of communication with Jalen Duren
quotes.excerpt: I have not spoken to the young man all summer
quotes.quote: I have not spoken to the young man all summer. So I don't know how that is. For me, I'm not going to hold anything against him. Again, I'll be happy to have him back. I'll be excited. He's been a huge part of our success. I think he'll continue to be a huge part of that going forward. But again, I can't control the different things that he does or his group does.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Shams Charania on the contract standoff between Jalen Duren and the Pistons
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Duren is missing the start of training camp and turning down a current five-year $200 million offer

text_blocks.speaker: Jorge Sedano
text_blocks.text: What do things stand between Duren and the Pistons with the deadline of a decision coming potentially on Thursday?

text_blocks.speaker: Shams Charania
text_blocks.text: The relationship has fractures in it to the point where now Jalen Duren is missing the start of training camp and turning down what sources say is a current five-year $200 million fully-guaranteed offer from the Detroit Pistons. These two sides are at a stalemate right now and that is clearly going to play a part here early in the Pistons season. But by Thursday we should have a resolution one way or the other.

quotes.speaker: Marc J. Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Marc J. Spears on potential trade destinations for Jalen Duren
quotes.excerpt: I'm hearing from an NBA GM told me the Milwaukee Bucks, the Atlanta Hawks, the Sacramento Kings

text_blocks.speaker: Jorge Sedano
text_blocks.text: How is the rest of the NBA reacting to this Duren saga?

text_blocks.speaker: Marc J. Spears
text_blocks.text: This is unprecedented territory. Jalen Duren hasn't even talked to Trajan for months. I don't think they've talked since the season ended. A Pistons source close to the Pistons told me that there's still optimism that they think he'll sign the big deal. But if not, I'm hearing from an NBA GM told me the Milwaukee Bucks, the Atlanta Hawks, the Sacramento Kings, and the Washington Wizards. If it is Anthony Davis and they want to do something, Anthony Davis is there now. He's ready to play now. He'd be motivated now. Trajan will have to make pick up the phone.
